PX15-03.name: The CancerNinja Cancerd
PX15-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit, or your Spirit with [Soul Core] on it attacks, the opponent can only block if they block with two Spirits or two Ultimates. When that Spirit is blocked, choose one of them to battle against.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
